objective: Continue the full Oyatie mockup toward Bominal-grade completeness by upgrading the Action Inbox / Priority Queue into a dense selectable bulk-operation command surface.

bominal_patterns_reviewed: /tmp/bominal-ref/app-bizos.jsx Business logic catalog and task table patterns

gap_analysis.source: current runtime inspection after Business Logic OS polish
findings_addressed: The Action Inbox rail destination had good rows but lacked Bominal-style selection, bulk operations, and operational summary density.
Rows were single buttons, limiting visual affordances for selection, routing, mail briefs, and evidence handling.
The Command Center needed stronger ties between action queue items, Workflow, Mail, Audit, and the Activity Center.

implemented: Added Action Inbox summary strip for blocking items, owned work, SLA pressure, and evidence links.
Added bulk-operation toolbar with select-all, selected-count status, Approve, Defer, Mail brief, and Attach evidence actions.
Converted inbox items from monolithic buttons into accessible row articles with checkboxes, row-main sidepeek trigger, and route action buttons.
Added local JS for visible-row select-all, selected row highlighting, bulk button enablement, bulk staged state, mail/audit route actions, filter synchronization, and Activity Center events.
Added CSS for selected/bulk-staged states, row actions, responsive bulkbar, and Bominal-style summary density.
Mirrored the Action Inbox enhancements in SSR static HTML so the command surface is present before hydration and interactive afterward.

observations: SSR output contains workbench-summary-strip, data-inbox-select, data-inbox-bulk, and inbox-row-main markup

verification.command: Playwright smoke for Action Inbox hash route, row selection, bulk mail action, blocking filter, audit route action, console/network health

visual_verdict.category_match: Bominal-style ActionInbox / Command Center priority queue integrated into Oyatie shell
visual_verdict.verdict: This slice improves the highest-priority command surface by making the Action Inbox look and behave like an enterprise operator queue: selectable rows, bulk actions, summary metrics, route actions, and local evidence/mail workflow feedback. It moves the mockup closer to a complete cohesive product rather than separate static panels.
improved_matches: Action Inbox now has Bominal-like bulk selection and command affordances instead of only clickable rows.
Rows connect directly to Workflow, Mail, and Audit routes while sidepeek inspection remains available.
Bulk operations update local row state, status text, active surface, and Activity Center count without pretending to persist backend mutations.
The UI remains within the existing neutral, low-radius, dense design system.
remaining_differences: No real workflow item API, approval backend, mail transport, or audit chain is wired.
Bominal's ActionInbox primitive supports deeper typed audit envelopes; this mockup now visualizes those affordances but remains local DOM state.
The full complete mockup objective is still broader than this slice and is not being marked complete.

non_claims: No real action item, approval, workflow, mail, or audit backend is contacted.
No selected item, bulk action, mail brief, approval, defer, or evidence state is persisted beyond local browser/DOM state.
No claim is made that the full complete mockup goal is finished.
